functional_requirements.title: Facilitation-only role attestation at onboarding
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall require every onboarding producer or distributor to explicitly attest that they, not HarvestLink, hold Food Business Operator status for any trade facilitated on the platform.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Directly restates CON-01's mitigation_summary as a testable onboarding step; FBO-status attestation is explicit in the mitigation, not inferred.

functional_requirements.title: Foodservice buyer discovery and matching
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall allow foodservice buyers to discover onboarded producers and distributors by product category, location, and compliance-documentation completeness score.
functional_requirements.reasoning: The value proposition names 'direct buyer discovery' explicitly; category/location/completeness-score are the natural discovery facets given the completeness score is used elsewhere in the roadmap.

functional_requirements.title: Dual sign-off traceability record entry
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall require both producer and distributor sign-off before a traceability record is finalised, and shall retain every finalised record in an immutable, append-only audit log.
functional_requirements.traces_to: vision.md § Regulatory Posture (traceability mitigation: producer and distributor dual sign-off, immutable audit log)
functional_requirements.reasoning: Directly restates CON-02's mitigation_summary — dual sign-off and immutable audit log are both explicit in the mitigation text.

functional_requirements.title: Producer-attested allergen declaration workflow
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall require producer attestation and sign-off before an allergen declaration is finalised on-platform.
functional_requirements.traces_to: vision.md § Regulatory Posture (allergen mitigation: producer attestation and sign-off before finalisation)

functional_requirements.title: Compliance-completeness-scaled transaction limits
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall set a producer's maximum transaction value according to their compliance-documentation completeness score, and re-evaluate that limit as the score changes.
functional_requirements.notes: Split from Roadmap Phase 3's compound clause — see compound_splits
functional_requirements.reasoning: Half of Phase 3's compound clause: 'transaction limits scaled to compliance-documentation completeness' is independently testable from the cohort cap half (FR-007) — a system could scale limits without restricting to a cohort, or vice versa.

functional_requirements.title: Facilitation-only transaction routing
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall never record HarvestLink as taking possession, title, or physical custody of food in any transaction; every trade shall be routed and documented as a direct producer/distributor-to-buyer arrangement.
functional_requirements.traces_to: vision.md § Regulatory Posture (FBO-status mitigation: HarvestLink never takes physical possession of food)
functional_requirements.reasoning: Restates CON-01's mitigation from the transaction-routing angle, distinct from FR-001's onboarding-attestation angle — both mitigate the same Red constraint via different mechanisms named in the same mitigation text.

functional_requirements.title: Pilot-phase cohort restriction
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall restrict onboarding and trading, during the pilot phase, to a cohort of producers/distributors explicitly designated eligible by the product/operations team.
functional_requirements.notes: Split from Roadmap Phase 3's compound clause — see compound_splits
functional_requirements.reasoning: The other half of Phase 3's compound clause — 'pilot launch with a capped cohort' — independently testable from the completeness-scaled-limits half (FR-005).

functional_requirements.title: Time-to-first-compliant-trade measurement
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall record, per producer, the elapsed time from onboarding start to first fully-documented, compliance-complete trade, and expose this for reporting against a target of under 14 days.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Directly restates NSM-01's metric and target as a measurable requirement.

functional_requirements.title: Compliance-documentation-completeness measurement
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall record, per producer, a compliance-documentation completeness score at first trade, and expose this for reporting against a target of at least 95%.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Directly restates NSM-02's metric and target as a measurable requirement.

compound_splits.source_clause_summary: Pilot launch with a capped cohort AND transaction limits scaled to completeness — vision.md Roadmap Phase 3
